Both proclamations use the same section 22 sequence: advice from the Secretary of Agriculture, referral to and report by the Tariff Commission, a presidential finding that imports threaten a price-support program and domestic processing, a necessity finding for quantitative limitations, and operative quotas divided by time period and foreign supplying country. They also make the same statutory finding that permissible quantities are not proportionately less than 50 percent of imports during a representative period. C05 and C24 share much of this machinery, but C03 most closely parallels the child's combination of numbered aggregate quotas, representative-period finding, and country
